corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) loop on the right leg (አድርጌሃለሁ, 'What have I done to you?'), which was misread as 6th-order ግ.
The 1st-person possessive suffix on መንግሥቴ ('my kingdom') is printed with the 5th-order ring ቴ, misread as 3rd-order ቲ.
Both visually (top-left hook of 6th-order ሕ) and philologically (Classical Ge'ez ዘእሕዩ ለክሙ, repeated explicitly in L20 እሕዩ ለክሙ), the character at the line wrap is ሕ, not ሐ.
